# TypingLevel

> TypingLevel is a free browser-based typing test and touch-typing practice site. It measures WPM, raw WPM, accuracy, and mistakes without requiring an account.

## Start here

- [Free typing test](https://how-type.com/): Take a one-minute test immediately or choose another duration.
- [1 minute typing test](https://how-type.com/1-minute-typing-test): A quick, repeatable WPM and accuracy check.
- [3 minute typing test](https://how-type.com/3-minute-typing-test): A longer test for a steadier view of typing pace.
- [5 minute typing test](https://how-type.com/5-minute-typing-test): Measure sustained typing speed and accuracy.
- [Learn touch typing](https://how-type.com/learn): Choose continuous practice or a fixed 15-lesson course.

## Explanations

- [How WPM is calculated](https://how-type.com/how-wpm-is-calculated): How correct WPM, raw WPM, and accuracy are calculated.
- [Average typing speed](https://how-type.com/average-typing-speed): A sourced typing-speed benchmark and guidance for fair comparisons.
- [Typing FAQ](https://how-type.com/faq): Answers about WPM, accuracy, mistakes, backspaces, and test duration.

## Data and access

- No account is required.
- Completed results and learning progress stay in the user's browser.
- Typed passages and individual keystrokes are not uploaded by the application.
- [About TypingLevel](https://how-type.com/about): Product purpose, scoring approach, sources, and privacy principles.
- [Contact TypingLevel](https://how-type.com/contact): Support email and useful details for reporting an issue.
- [Privacy notice](https://how-type.com/privacy)
- [XML sitemap](https://how-type.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Full agent-readable overview](https://how-type.com/llms-full.txt)
